title: Pressure pulse: sweeps (density, amplitude, width, particle scale, temperature, stiffness, k_s calibration)

modelComponents.integrator: drift → pair collisions → walls, velocity-Verlet kicks when forces present /1

geometry: periodic box 400 × 60; density excess 0.5 in a central slab of width 20

mach.note: This experiment MEASURES c_p. Later experiments report Mp = V/c_p using the c_p measured here for the matching configuration.

track.reason: poor linear fit of shift vs time (r² = 0.764)
poor linear fit of shift vs time (r² = 0.555)

ksCalibration.hypothesis: k_s = m c_p² / φ₀  ⇔  c_p² = k_s φ₀ / m  (slope 1 through the origin)
ksCalibration.note: Measured slope ≠ 1 means the relation does not describe this discretised occupancy universe at the tested temperature and kernel width; it is not adjusted to fit.

uncertainty.note: c_p, attenuation and width growth: jackknife over seeds of the seed-averaged profiles.

convergence.note: Resolution, width, amplitude and particle-scale dependence are cases of the sweep experiment.

benchmarks.note: Classical references for comparison only. Hard-disk adiabatic: c² = (kT/m)(Z + φZ′ + Z²), c_v = k, Henderson Z.

acceptance.description: No run halted by the safety monitor
Rigid-contact models close the energy ledger to round-off
Force-integrated models (occupancy, soft contact) conserve energy to the integrator accuracy
A propagating pulse is identified and tracked in every case
acceptance.criterion: shift vs time linear with r² > 0.9 and ≥ 5 snapshots, in every case
acceptance.measured: not tracked: A φ=0.05 (poor linear fit of shift vs time (r² = 0.764)); A amplitude 1.0 (poor linear fit of shift vs time (r² = 0.555))

acceptance.description: Disturbance speed measured precisely enough to compare models
acceptance.criterion: 95 % CI half-width < 5 % in every case (jackknife over seeds)
